item.title: Morning brief, Wednesday November 25
item.description: Good morning, Sydney. It's Wednesday, November twenty fifth, the day before Thanksgiving. Before you open Instagram or TikTok: if your F1 Vegas recap isn't posted yet, cut it and post it before you hit the road, then spend about thirty minutes replying to comments and messages. For an easy story today, share the drive up to the mountains. Your one big thing today is getting to the mountain house smoothly and switching into holiday mode. Before you go, pay for your ShopGoodwill win, the Versace satin pants, which is due tonight. Your schedule, in Mountain time: the drive to the mountain house is blocked from ten to noon, your call with Lily about the Arizona house is at two, Gabe has a call with Ahmad at three, and dinner at Sage Brush is at six. Weather: Denver is about thirty three degrees and partly cloudy this morning. Up around Granby it's sunny, with a high near forty three and a low around seventeen tonight. No flights for you today. Enjoy the mountains, and have a wonderful day.
